adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from `.find(...)` to `.filter(...)` and then iterated (`for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`). The recurring-series deletion sweep (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings) { ... }`) now lives inside that per-reference loop, so it will execute once per calendar reference, re-running the full `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).map(...)` × `for (const updBooking of updatedBookings)` deletion pass multiple times. Additionally, inside that sweep it still does `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, which only selects the first calendar reference per remaining booking, so multi-reference (e.g., collective) bookings will not have all hosts’ calendar events deleted (orphans), while the first reference gets duplicate `deleteEvent` calls.
